hooks.command: skill=$(jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty'); [ "$skill" = "speckit-specify" ] || exit 0; command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; latest=$(curl -fsS --max-time 5 https://api.github.com/repos/github/spec-kit/releases/latest 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.tag_name // empty'); [ -z "$latest" ] && exit 0; receipt="$HOME/.local/share/uv/tools/specify-cli/uv-receipt.toml"; installed=$(grep -oE 'rev=[^"]+' "$receipt" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); if [ -n "$installed" ] && [ "$installed" != "$latest" ]; then uv tool install specify-cli --from "git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@${latest}" --force >/dev/null 2>&1 && jq -n --arg from "$installed" --arg to "$latest" '{systemMessage: ("specify-cli updated " + $from + " -> " + $to)}'; fi; exit 0
